rank_math_title: 5 Day Sossusvlei and Etosha Tour from Windhoek
rank_math_desc: 5 day Sossusvlei and Etosha tour from Windhoek: 2 nights in Etosha, AfriCat cheetahs, Dune 45 and Deadvlei, breakfast and dinner. From USD 3,500.
post_content: This 5 day Sossusvlei and Etosha tour combines game drives in Etosha National Park, the AfriCat Foundation and the red dunes of Sossusvlei on a private guided trip from Windhoek.
overview:
This 5 day Sossusvlei and Etosha tour is a private guided trip from Windhoek that combines Namibia's best wildlife park with its red desert dunes. You spend 2 nights in Etosha National Park, 1 night in Windhoek after a visit to the AfriCat Foundation, and 1 night near Sossusvlei. Breakfast and dinner are included, and the price starts from USD 3,500 per adult.

It suits first-time visitors to Namibia, couples and photographers who want wildlife and scenery in a short trip, travelling in an air-conditioned 4x4 with a professional English-speaking guide.

Why choose a 5 day Sossusvlei and Etosha tour?

Etosha and Sossusvlei are Namibia's two headline sights, and this tour fits both into five days. In Etosha, animals concentrate around waterholes in a semi-arid park, which makes for easy game viewing. In the Namib Desert, the orange dunes of Sossusvlei, coloured by iron oxide over many years, are among the most photographed landscapes in Africa.

  • Short on time: wildlife and desert in one 5-day trip from Windhoek.
  • Photographers: sunrise on the dunes, Deadvlei and a sundowner at Elim Dune.
  • Conservation: a visit to the AfriCat Foundation on the Okonjima Nature Reserve.

What to expect on the 5 day Sossusvlei and Etosha tour

Day 1 starts with a pick-up at your Windhoek hotel or the airport and a drive to the southern side of Etosha National Park, with lunch on the way or at the lodge and an afternoon game drive. Day 2 is a full day of game drives around Etosha's waterholes, looking for mammals and birds such as Sociable Weaver and Crimson-breasted Shrike.

On day 3 you leave early and drive to Windhoek via the Okonjima Nature Reserve, home of the AfriCat Foundation, where you learn about Namibia's large carnivores and see the ambassador cheetahs. The evening in Windhoek is free.

Day 4 is the drive south from Windhoek to the desert, with a lunch stop, then Dune 45 and a sundowner at Elim Dune. On day 5 you enter the Namib-Naukluft Park at first light for Sossusvlei and Deadvlei, visit Sesriem Canyon and drive back to Windhoek, where the tour ends.

Is 5 days enough for Sossusvlei and Etosha?

Five days is enough to see the highlights of both Etosha and Sossusvlei, but it is a busy trip with long drives on days 3, 4 and 5. If you want more time at the waterholes, the 7 day Etosha National Park safari spends 6 nights inside the park. Our best time to visit Namibia guide helps you choose dates.

What is included in this Namibia tour?

The price includes accommodation on the itinerary, an air-conditioned 4x4 vehicle, a professional English-speaking guide, breakfast and dinner, all activities on the itinerary, park entrance fees, drinking water on board, passenger liability insurance and an airport transfer.

Not included are flights, visas, health insurance, personal items and tips. Read our Etosha safari guide and our ultimate Namibia safari guide before you travel.

How much does the 5 day Sossusvlei and Etosha tour cost?

From USD 3,500 per adult. The final price depends on your travel dates, group size and lodge availability, and we confirm every detail in your written quote.

faq.q: When is the best time for the 5 day Sossusvlei and Etosha tour?
faq.a: The 5 day Sossusvlei and Etosha tour runs all year. The dry season, roughly May to October, is usually best for Etosha, when wildlife gathers at the waterholes, and the cooler months make dune walks at Sossusvlei easier. Tell us your dates and we will advise on conditions.

faq.q: What is included in the 5 day Sossusvlei and Etosha tour?
faq.a: The 5 day Sossusvlei and Etosha tour includes accommodation, an air-conditioned 4x4, an English-speaking guide, breakfast and dinner, all activities including the AfriCat visit, park fees, water on board, passenger liability insurance and an airport transfer. Flights, visas, health insurance, personal items and tips are extra.

faq.q: Where do you stay on the Sossusvlei and Etosha tour?
faq.a: On the Sossusvlei and Etosha tour you stay 2 nights at a lodge on the southern side of Etosha National Park, 1 night in Windhoek and 1 night near Sossusvlei. The trip page does not name the lodges, so we confirm each one in your written quote.

faq.q: Is the 5 day Sossusvlei and Etosha tour suitable for children?
faq.a: Yes, children are welcome on the 5 day Sossusvlei and Etosha tour, as it is a private tour. Days 3, 4 and 5 include long drives, and dune climbs are optional. Tell us your children's ages and we will suggest family rooms and the best pace.
